arStrings.szText: {c_important}Whirlwind{/c} explodes every {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 0"]{/c} seconds dealing {c:FF44A68E}[Affix_Value_1*100|%|]{/c} increased damage as Fire. {c_important}Critical Strikes{/c} with {c_important}Whirlwind{/c} reduce the time until the next explosion by {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 1"|1|]{/c} seconds down to {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 2"]{/c} second.
